desc: Characterize all possible adjacent ratios S_i/S_{i+1} from f(S_i/S_{i+1})=A_i, deriving constraints on shared prime-exponent differences and reciprocal orientation.
Decompose the problem by prime factors appearing in the input A_i, since different primes interact only through the global gcd normalization.
Implement the per-prime first-global-minimum split DP for a single prime, computing forward strictly-positive and backward nonnegative walks and combining them without modular division.
Combine the per-prime F_p values by multiplication modulo 998244353 and produce the final answer.
Verify the implementation against all three samples, including N=2, A_i=1, and repeated prime cases.
Finalize the Python program to read from stdin, write to stdout, and handle edge cases such as zero-step edges and boundary indices k=1 or k=N.
